items.b: 8.41-CARAT PINK DIAMOND CARRIES A HK$95M CHRISTIE'S ESTIMATE
items.t: The fancy vivid purple-pink stone works out at HK$11.3m a carat. A Cartier brooch with a 10.10-carat Burmese ruby carries HK$60m at the same 24 November Hong Kong sale.

items.b: SILVER ADDS $1.48 AND RETAKES MONDAY'S MARK, GOLD STAYS UNDER
items.t: All four metals rose on the 05:02 ET tape. Silver's 2.35% is the largest move; gold is still $18.40 under Monday's mark and platinum $17.00 under.

items.b: ROLEX PRICES THE PERPETUAL PADELLONE FROM US$59,000
items.t: The annual calendar arrives outside Watches and Wonders. Platinum lists at US$66,200 and the Everose on a Settimo bracelet at US$72,800, a 23.4% step.

items.b: 30 MINUTES TO UNDER FIVE: DE BEERS SHIPS SYNTHDETECT 2
items.t: The screening instrument takes at least 25 minutes off a full tray scan on the company's own figures. No price, tray capacity or throughput is published.

items.b: PANDORA MUST FACE FOUNDRAE'S COPYRIGHT SUIT OVER TALISMAN CHARMS
items.t: Judge Colleen McMahon denied the motion to dismiss on 10 September over two medallion designs. No damages figure and no trial date are set.

items.b: LAGOS NAMES KEITH ROLFE CEO, 49 YEARS AFTER ITS FOUNDING
items.t: The Philadelphia house promoted its chief financial and operating officer on 10 September. Founder Steven Lagos keeps executive chairman, creative director and innovation officer.

items.b: GCAL BY SARINE OPENS A THIRD LAB, IN MUMBAI'S SEEPZ
items.t: The jewellery certification site is the second in India, alongside Surat and New York. No investment, capacity or staff figure is published.
